cards.real_5e_name: Circlet of Quick Wits (house: quadruped Int crown)

plain_mechanics.text: Worn on the head by one creature (no attunement); it resizes to fit any quadruped or biped. Once per long rest, the wearer may make one Intelligence check, or one Charisma (Persuasion) check against a creature that has not met the wearer, with Advantage; say so before rolling. Dormant until the wearer reaches level 3: the Sepsis rider. Once per long rest, right after you hit with an attack, the target makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.
plain_mechanics.limits: One Advantage per long rest and no always-on bonus. The Sepsis rider does nothing until the wearer is level 3 (a named step; the GM re-checks the budget then), is once per long rest, and does nothing to creatures immune to Poisoned. It gives a non-sapient wearer no speech. Whoever wears it uses it; a quadruped companion can wear it. Not bound: it can be traded, sold or looted from a corpse like any item. Story hook only: wearing it enters the wearer in the Blood Sultanate line of succession (a Floor 9 thread; no effect on Floors 1-2). Fleeting was removed (an item that vanishes when it leaves the head cannot be traded or looted).

cards.spoken_line: Tiara of Bloody Succession, Circlet of Quick Wits. Once per rest, Advantage on one Intelligence check. Fits any quadruped.
cards.snark_line: Every four-legged Crawler deserves a crown, and this one comes with a grudge.
cards.reward: Tiara of Bloody Succession, Circlet of Quick Wits. Once per rest, Advantage on one Intelligence check. Fits any quadruped.

cards.real_5e_name: Ring of Divine Suffering (house: Marked for Death ring)

plain_mechanics.text: Once per long rest, spend 30 seconds of focus (outside combat) to mark one hostile non-Crawler creature you can see within 60 ft that the GM agrees is a real threat (a fictional rival fits; no vermin, no noncombatants). The mark lasts up to 1 hour. You have Advantage on the first attack roll you make against the marked creature, and the mark ends when you make it. Marking never requires or rewards a kill.
plain_mechanics.duration: up to 1 hour or until your first attack on the mark
plain_mechanics.limits: One mark at a time, one Advantage per long rest. It never marks a Crawler (no PvP). It runs only with the table's session-zero opt-in: the rival is fictional, never a real person and never a child, and a killing blow is not a deed. No healing is blocked and no hit points or Inspiration are restored. Hunters of Floor 6 will target the wearer (GM hook, no effect on Floors 1-2). No permanent stat bonus. No attunement. Not bound: it can be traded, sold or looted from a corpse like any item.

cards.spoken_line: Grudge Ring, Ring of Divine Suffering. Once per long rest, mark a foe: no healing until it dies, then full health. Opt-in only.
cards.snark_line: It sounds scary because it is, and it does not care who you were angry at.
cards.reward: Grudge Ring, Ring of Divine Suffering. Once per long rest, mark a foe: no healing until it dies, then full health. Opt-in only.

plain_mechanics.text: A Maul (2d6 Bludgeoning, Heavy, Two-Handed, Topple, 10 lb). Dormant until the party reaches Floor 3: it becomes a +1 maul (+1 bonus to attack and damage rolls).

cards.real_5e_name: Pin of Settled Scores (house: grudge charm)

plain_mechanics.text: Pin worn on clothing (no attunement). When you earn it, name one fictional rival or estranged relative from your backstory (never a real person, never a child; the GM approves the name). Once per long rest, when you must make a saving throw against being Frightened by that rival or anyone acting for them, you have Advantage on that save. The first time the table plays out that rival being beaten, spared or forgiven (never killed), you gain Heroic Inspiration, once ever; after that the pin has no Inspiration left.
plain_mechanics.limits: PvP never counts and the rival is never another Crawler. A killing blow is not a deed. cards.deed: Every Crawler present carried out a distinct part of one plan, and it worked
cards.notes: Table deed (rules/45 section 6.2): counts as the one Story Box deed of every Crawler named in the deed line; the GM names every pictured Crawler in --witness and logs the others as sharing it. Pattern: Trophy (rung 0 plus a navigation perk). trigger_deed: every Crawler present (the Crawlers pictured when the deed is recorded) each did a distinct, necessary part of one improvised plan against something above their weight, unscripted, with real risk. power_note: Story and navigation only, no combat numbers. Hook: if one Crawler dies, the photo greys them out where everyone can see. REVIEW (Lore): snark line trimmed to one sentence for deck_check; 'all four Crawlers' became 'every Crawler pictured' (the Crawlers present when the deed is recorded), so it works for a two-Crawler table; the once-per-floor replay now uses uses.recharge 'floor' (new value, added to deck_check; Syndicate to add 'floor' to the recharge list in rules/40 section 1.1). Death before a saferoom (Caleb's 2026-10-04 ruling): an unopened Story Box is reclaimed if the Crawler dies before a saferoom, and the slot is freed (the one-per-floor cap no longer counts it; the GM may award a Story Box again). This replaces the older rule where the box stayed closed and the cap stayed used. sale_value 100 (System buyback at Floor-1 scale, multiplied by the sale floor's credits multiplier at runtime; independent of story_value, which is provenance only and never the buyback base). story_value is provenance (what the deed was worth to the Accountant), not a sale price; bound is false: the item can be looted, traded or sold like any item (Caleb's ruling 2026-10-04).

deck_notes: Story Boxes are hand-pick only (draw_weight 0) and GM-triggered for one named, one-time deed. Like every loot box, a Story Box can only be opened in a saferoom. The deed is recorded and announced at award; the box then waits unopened until the next saferoom. If the Crawler dies before that saferoom, the unopened box is reclaimed and the slot is freed (Caleb's 2026-10-04 ruling; the one-per-floor cap no longer counts it). Story Box items are NOT bound (bound is false): they can be looted from a corpse, traded or sold, as in canon. story_value is provenance for the Accountant, not a sale price; sale_value is the System buyback at Floor-1 scale (times the sale floor's multiplier); credit_value stays 0. Cap one per table per floor (log an override to exceed).
